summary: Kodiak Sciences filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing a press release dated September 28, 2026, reporting topline results from the Phase 3 DAYBREAK study in wet age-related macular degeneration. Zenkuda (tarcocimab tedromer) met its primary endpoint with a p-value of 0.0007, while tabirafusp-ted (KSI-501) met the vision primary endpoint (p=0.0036) and an anatomical key secondary endpoint (p=0.0001), with 54% of Zenkuda patients on 24-week dosing. A multi-indication BLA is planned for Q4 2026. No deal terms, advisors or board recommendations were disclosed; this is a clinical data event, not a special situation.
